method: Closing CATALOG-DEPTH.md's rv gaps for Storyteller Overland, Grech RV, Westfalia and Knaus against each brand's whole range as counted in docs/research/catalog-ranges.json (from docs/research/catalog/ranges-d.json). A model is taken only where both its price and its gross weight were read, within the US's class D/C 26,000 lb or Britain's category B 3,500 kg car-license cap, per tools/build-rvs.mjs. Storyteller's GXV Epic is not taken even though its price was found: its own spec sheet (read via search, rv.com and giantrv.com listings) states a 33,000 lb GVWR, over the US cap, so it isn't a vehicle a car license drives. Grech's LUSSO-ion Lounge and LUSSO Tour prices were read on grechrv.com's own pages, but no source in this session stated their GVWR specifically (only a same-chassis sibling, Strada-ion Lounge, at 11,030 lb) and a weight carried over from a different model is a guess, so both are left out. Westfalia's and Knaus's own sites (westfalia-mobil.com, knaus.com) gave prices and weights for Columbus, James Cook and the VAN TI VANSATION; the rest of each brand's missing list (Westfalia's Nansen, Columbus Liner, Meridian, Club Joker Urban, Jules Verne, Kipling; Knaus's other eight VAN TI/L!VE/BOXTIME variants) are left for a later pass, named in notFound.
